avis.titre: Did Help with Breakouts,  a Bit Drying
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try this product as I am a big fan of the brand and I tend to get small breakouts every once in awhile. I have extremely dry skin so I was a bit nervous to try this product. Overall, I thought the product was okay. It did dry out my skin a bit and the texture of the serum was a bit sticky. I tried to not overuse the product and only used it during breakouts. I only applied the product at night. I do think the serum helped with the break outs, but I'm not sure if it helped enough for me to consider getting the serum once it's gone.

avis.titre: Amazing for sensitive, acne prone skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin that can break out easily when trying new products, so I love to have a good spot treatment on hand. I don't know what kind of magic they put in this little bottle, but it makes any pimple disappear overnight. It's great! If you're sensitive to scents, it smells like a treatment, but it's light and goes away quickly.

This is a great spot treatment! I found it to be effective without being irritating like some acne treatments can be. Things to note would be that it can be a bit sticky if you use a lot, and that it does have a bit of an herbal type of fragrance, but i am sensitive to most fragrance and it didn't bother me.

This was very effective for my hormonal acne. I don't have a ton of acne and I'm not sure I would rub this all over my face (it is strong), but for spot treatment it works. It dried out my pimple and helped not have a dark hyperpigmentation once the acne cleared.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've really liked this treatment! It is very smooth on application and feels like great quality! It definitely helped my completion and reduced acne and breakouts. I'd recommend

avis.titre: Smells a bit weird, but works well!

It absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn't feel to irritating, and I do think that it helped my acne spots heal more quickly than they would have without!

Overall, I think this performs pretty well if your skin isn't bothered by fragrance and you're looking for something that can visibly improve the appearance of your breakouts overnight.

avis.titre: I will definitely be repurchasing this product
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with this product overall, especially in terms of duration, consistency, formulation, clarity, and prevention. The consistency is lightweight and smooth, making it easy to apply without feeling sticky or heavy on the skin. The formulation feels well-balanced and gentle, absorbing quickly while still leaving the skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. In terms of clarity, it gives the skin a healthier, more radiant appearance over time and helps improve the look of dullness and uneven texture. I also like the duration of the results—it keeps my skin feeling moisturized and looking fresh throughout the day without needing constant reapplication. What stands out most is its preventive benefit: with continued use, it seems to help maintain the skin barrier, reduce dryness, and support a smoother, more resilient complexion before bigger skin concerns develop. Overall, it feels like a reliable skincare staple for both immediate hydration and long-term skin maintenance.

avis.titre: Great acne fighting product that doesn't over-dry
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Lancôme Clarifique works wonders for my acne. It dries up the affected area without over-drying. The product has a faint floral scent that is not overpowering and isn't sticky after applying.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For me it's an okay acne treatment. For the first 24-48 hours of using it, I had more blemishes appear but it also helped calm some I already have. It kinda felt like my skin was purging. The serum is thin and absorbs quickly. It has a strong chemical and perfume scent; there's fragrance listed in ingredients. I have mixed opinion on this because it helped some of my blemishes but I also continued to have new blemishes form.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this for about a month now. And I absolutely love this product. It has cleared up so much of my acne, and leaves my skin feeling so soft. Also bonus, it smells really good. This is officially a part of my routine now. Also a little goes a long way so it will last a while.

avis.titre: Worked quickly on my facial acne
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have a mixed opinion on this Lancome Clarifique anti-blemish BX-interceptor product. I used it on two different bumps I had and experienced 2 different outcomes. I used it on each bump for at least 3 days. The first bump, I used it on was around my collar bone. Even after a week it was still there. It has gotten smaller and not as red but it's still there. However, I had incredible results using it on my face. I had a bump come up on my chin and in three days of using Lancome Clarifique anti-blemish it was almost completely gone and not noticeable. This product dries quickly, which I liked. I would say this product can give mixed results. This first thing I was drawn to with this product is it's beautiful push button on the lid of the dropper pipette. I think I will continue to use it for my facial acne but not so much for my body acne. It contains 2% salicylic acid for acne blemishes, blackheads, and whiteheads. It's an ultra-concentrated complex with vitamin B5 + Niacinamide, Glycolic acid, Azelaic acid Derivative, and Bixa-beech bud extract. I do notice a smell, but I can't pinpoint what it smells like. The smell is from the ingredients, it gives off a floral or fruity scent, in my opinion. It has a different smell that some may not like. Personally, I did like the scent.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product makes a lot of acne clearing and prevention claims that it doesn't completely live up to unfortunately. I have a few different blemish clearing salicylic acid serums and i noticed after initially testing this one for 2 weeks, i was always reaching for other brands that actually worked. Unfortunately, this one does not clear blemishes nearly as quickly as other ones I've tried. As for prevention, due to the triple acid blend AND niacinamide, with daily use this can actually cause blemishes due to it weakening the skin barrier. I experienced more breakouts on my chin after the 2 weeks of using this to try and clear some texture on my forehead and breakouts on my cheek. Unfortunately, this is not a product i will be repurchasing or recommending as it didn't work for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This acne treatment was one of the better ones I've used. Did a good job of clearing small acne and smelled good. Was very light and not sticky or painful as I have sensitive skin.

This was an effective acne spot treatment but it did take a couple of uses for full treatment to work at clearing the entire spot. I used this on dry skin and patted in twice a day. I didn't mind the slight fragrance and the texture was not too drying on the skin. I received this for free in exchange for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This acne treatment serum is great! It actually clears pimples fairly fast, some as little as overnight, without drying out the skin like other products! Leaves my skin feeling nice, looking smooth, & acne free! I really enjoyed this treatment & will continue to purchase it when I'm out of this bottle!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Has a nice refreshing smell while clarifying skin and helping get rid of acne. I used it over the course of two weeks and it helped clear up my skin significantly

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like how this goes on thin and blends right in with my skin care routine. I like the subtle plant smell. Didn't notice any new breakouts due use of this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall i am a big fan of the Lancôme brand. This product t does not change that. I was very impressed with how fast it reduced my breakouts. I didn't not feel any irritation and the scent was not horrible for what it is.

I don't usually get acne all over my face so a product like this is great to use a spot treatment or to pinpoint one area. I enjoyed the feel and scent of this product and it definitely helped calm any pimples down. I will be keeping this product on hand for any acne emergencies.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice lightweight anti-blemish serum. Its active ingredient is Salicylic acid, which is pretty common for acne treatments. This is a nice formula though, it is lightweight and does not leave a sticky residue. It has a nice light floral scent.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been really impressed with the Lancôme Clarifique Acne Treatment. It feels light weight, absorbs quickly and doesn't irritate my skin at all. I noticed fewer breakouts and calmer skin within a short time and it layers well with the rest of my skin care. My skin looks clearer and more balanced without feeling dry. Defiantly a great option if you're dealing with acne but want something gentle and effective.

This product is definitely effective for combating acne. I've been using it for six weeks whenever a pimple appears, including on sweat-induced body acne, and it actually seems to fade them away with one to two uses. Packaging: the bottle is pretty, and it does seem like a good deal of product. The glass dropper has a button built into the lid, which you can press to suck the product up into the dropper, and then dispense it. Because of this you can dispense product easily without touching the dropper. However, it can be somewhat tricky to maneuver the dropper with one hand, especially if you have moisturizer on your hands or something along those lines. Scent: The serum has a distinct scent that reminds me of a "sea salt" perfume I once had. Very ocean. I love those kinds of scents so I'm here for it, but someone who is sensitive to scents might not be so happy about it. Consistency: The serum is pretty sticky and feels not exactly pleasant upon application. It does dry down within several minutes generally and becomes less sticky. It's pretty liquidy. Effectiveness: I noticed a difference within half a day of application on targeted acne zones. When I used more of an entire zone application, I feel there was increased brightness in those areas the next day. Make sure to wear sunscreen when using this product, of course. Overall, I think this is an effective product that is good to have in your skincare arsenal if you get occasional acne. The price is not too outrageous for

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Lancome acne treatment works well at drying out blemish areas. It doesnt feel sticky or greasy. A little bit goes a long way and if you use it too much will dry out your skin. Overall successful!!

I absolutely love this product! I had a pretty gnarly pimple on my jaw line and this stuff dried it up within days without drying out the skin around the blemish. It has a pleasant smell and is super easy to add into your routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This helped clear up some acne spots I had been experiencing on my chin! Didnt cause any irritation and has a very light scent. The packaging is great as usual with Lancôme products.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product helped clear most of my hormonal acne (chin and cheeks)! I used this serum at night mostly, so upon waking, my skin looked clearer! It does have a nice scent and the dropper is kinda neat! Def give this a try.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't have time to really test how well it worked on breakouts (used it twice and it seemed to work) as my skin happened to be very clear this month. However, I have very sensitive skin and can confirm it was not irritated at all! I also LOVED the applicator! Can't wait to continue trying this product

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like it. The formula was like a gel so that was cool. Skin didn't get all dry and flaky. Seemed to work pretty well although I don't break out much anymore.

I received this product complimentary but all thoughts are my own. Omg I am thrilled with this product! I have been using glycolic acid for years and it didn't seem to be helping my acne at all. I ran out of it and started using this and it's been day and night. Exactly what my skin needs. I will continue to use this in my routine forever.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product works great! I used it on a small zit I had gotten and it completely went away the next day! I definitely recommend! It's a little on the pricey side but would recommend if you need a reliable product!

avis.titre: Fast-acting acne treatment that helps clear blemishes while
avis.texte: This acne treatment works quickly and effectively. It absorbs fast, feels lightweight on the skin, and helps reduce the appearance of breakouts without leaving a sticky residue. After using it consistently I noticed my skin became more smoother and refined, especially in area where there is occasional breakout and texture.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love how this keeps my skin balanced without drying it out. Helps shrink bumps and smooth texture. Easy, clean, and reliable for blemish control.

avis.titre: The Acne Treatment That Worked Wonders!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the Lancôme Clarifique Bx-Interceptor for free in exchange for my honest review, and honestly, I'm absolutely loving it! The first thing I noticed was the scent - it's quite strong and floral, which is lovely but may be overwhelming if you're sensitive to scented products. Also, the packaging is absolutely gorgeous! It looks/feels luxurious and well-thought-out, especially the top button dispenser. It makes applying the serum so easy and mess-free, which I really appreciate. A little goes a long way... so this bottle will last ages! The formula itself is lightweight and comfortable, not drying or irritating at all. It takes a bit of time to fully absorb, but once it does, it sits nicely on the skin. What I love most is how effective it's been at managing my breakouts. As shown in my overnight before-and-after photo, the corner of my nose breakout literally disappeared like magic! Overall, this serum is gentle enough for daily use and has become a trusted part of my skincare routine. Highly recommend!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product takes several uses for a pimple to go away. I have dry skin with hormonal acne. The photos show my pimple before and after using this for 3 days. As you can see, there is still a bit of redness in this area. The treatment doesn't dry out the skin too bad, which is nice, and the applicator is easy to use too.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed using this skincare product. It has helped with my breakouts. It gets rid of my pimple over night and takes 2-3 days for stubborn ones. It has a mild beautiful floral scent. Does not leave redness nor flaking on my skin. The packaging is glass and beautiful. Comes with a dropper easy to use.

avis.titre: Love for body acne, slightly strong for face
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The picture is 24 hours after applying to a large pimple. There is a light scent, and it's a strong formula so it might be too harsh if you have very sensitive skin. However, because it's a light serum it's very comfortable. It warns to wear proper sun protection, and due to the harsh formula please do! Overall it works quick, but I did feel like the pimple was still very noticeable and sometimes I have better luck with pimple patches. I do like this serum for body acne better, so if you struggle with that I think this could be a good option.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am in the process of moving and the stress is really causing a lot of breakouts - so I've truly put this to the test. I like that you can apply it multiple times a day. It's super smooth on the skin and not drying to my skin. The consistency is smooth and easy to rub in to your skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product was great on my acne and my skin. It got rid of my blemishes. Felt smooth and has good ingredients. The consistency was good as well. Great product for acne!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Lancôme Clarifique worked better than I expected for occasional breakouts. When I felt a blemish starting to form, I applied a small amount directly to the area, and it seemed to help calm things down before it became a full breakout. It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or greasy. I also like that it layers well with the rest of my skin care and make up without peeling. The formula feels gentle on my skin and I didn't notice any dryness or irritation while using it. It's not an overnight miracle, but I didn't notice that the blooms look red and seem to go away faster. The packaging is easy to use and a little goes a long way.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This stuff WORKS! It isn't drying and smells so so so luxurious. Honestly I like it even without having acne. It is hydrating to my dry skin! It does not cause my any redness.

I really like this acne treatment from Lancôme. Its easy to apply without any hustle love the way my skin turned out in just few days. For sure worth it and for the skin type i have it is really helpful my first choice for the acne treatment and never gonna change

avis.titre: Great but space out if using retinol
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So far I am seeing great results with this treatment! I like how thin the consistency is and I enjoy the smell and appreciate that it's not overwhelming the fragrant. I also really like the applicator. The pores on my nose seem to be less raised and it leaves my skin feeling soft and dewy. I am seeing the most results on my forehead, as well as the few that come around randomly in my hairline. I will say the first time I use this product, I wasn't thinking about the fact that it could interfere with my current retinol routine, so it did sting a little bit. However, once I properly implemented it into my weekly skincare cycle, it has never happened since. So I would recommend this product, but would urge retinol users to carefully implement it into their routine :)

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] What I appreciate most is that it treat blemishes without making my skin feel overly dry or irritated. My skin look smoother , and some post-acne marks appeared less noticeable overtime.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Poor results. Not medical grade skin care obviously but I used consistently and didn't see a change in my acne. I think the ingredients could be better.
